source_text: Population-level implementation in high-incidence settings has correlated with HIV incidence declines; for instance, modeling from Ugandan trial data projected that sustained VMMC uptake could avert up to 20% of new infections in priority countries by controlling for behavioral confounders like partner concurrency.
